name: Exp_CCI_Histogram
summary: This EA trades based on a custom CCI_Histogram indicator, opening buy positions when the histogram transitions from neutral to positive zone and sell positions when it transitions from neutral to negative zone. It uses configurable money management modes, stop loss/take profit, and processes signals only on new bars to avoid over-trading.
summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义CCI_Histogram指标进行交易，当直方图从中性区转为正区时开多仓，从中性区转为负区时开空仓。它支持可配置的资金管理模式、止损止盈，并且仅在新K线出现时处理信号以避免过度交易。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于CCI指标的直方图表现形式，通过判断CCI值相对于超买超卖阈值（+100/-100）的位置来识别动量方向变化。入场条件为：当直方图前一柱处于中性区（Col[1]==0）且当前柱进入正值区（Col[0]>0）时开多仓；当前一柱处于中性区（Col[1]==2）且当前柱进入负值区（Col[0]<2）时开空仓。出场条件为：当出现反向信号时平仓，即多仓在出现卖出信号时平仓，空仓在出现买入信号时平仓。仓位管理支持五种模式：按自由保证金比例、按余额比例、按净自由保证金比例、按净余额比例、固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制仓位大小，MMMode参数决定计算方式，默认使用固定手数模式（LOT=0.1手）。策略仅在SignalBar为0时逐Tick检查信号，否则等待新K线形成后才检查，减少不必要的计算。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on a histogram representation of the CCI indicator, identifying momentum direction changes by evaluating CCI values relative to overbought/oversold thresholds (+100/-100). Entry conditions: a buy position opens when the previous histogram bar is in the neutral zone (Col[1]==0) and the current bar enters the positive zone (Col[0]>0); a sell position opens when the previous bar is in the neutral zone (Col[1]==2) and the current bar enters the negative zone (Col[0]<2). Exit conditions: positions are closed on reverse signals—long positions close when a sell signal appears, and short positions close when a buy signal appears. Position sizing supports five modes: percentage of free margin, percentage of balance, percentage of net free margin, percentage of net balance, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter for position size and MMMode for calculation method, defaulting to fixed lot mode (LOT=0.1). The strategy only checks signals tick-by-tick when SignalBar is 0, otherwise it waits for a new bar to form before evaluating, reducing unnecessary computation.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理参数，控制仓位大小
parameters.description_en: Money management ratio or fixed lot size

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式（自由保证金/余额/净自由保证金/净余额/固定手数）
parameters.description_en: Lot mode: free margin/balance/post-loss margin/post-loss balance/fixed lot

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 信号K线索引（0=当前K线，1=已完成K线）

pros: 策略逻辑清晰，基于CCI动量转换识别趋势起点，信号定义明确
支持多种资金管理模式，灵活性高，可根据账户规模选择合适的仓位计算方式
新K线过滤机制减少了重复信号和过度交易的风险
止损止盈参数可配置，具备基本的风险控制框架
买卖方向可独立开关控制，便于只做多或只做空的定向交易
pros_en: Clear strategy logic based on CCI momentum transitions to identify trend starts, with well-defined signal conditions
Multiple money management modes provide flexibility to choose appropriate position sizing based on account size
New bar filtering mechanism reduces duplicate signals and over-trading risk
Configurable stop loss and take profit parameters provide a basic risk control framework
Buy and sell directions can be independently toggled, enabling directional-only trading strategies
cons: 止损1000点和止盈2000点数值过大，在大多数品种上可能导致实际风险远超预期
缺少点差过滤和波动率过滤，在市场剧烈波动或高点差时段可能产生不利成交
没有持仓检查和重复开仓保护，可能因信号持续而重复开仓
依赖自定义指标CCI_Histogram，指标加载失败则EA完全无法运行
SignalBar=1时仅在新K线检查信号，可能错过快速行情的最佳入场点
cons_en: Stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points are excessively large, potentially causing much greater actual risk than expected on most instruments
Lacks spread filter and volatility filter, which may result in unfavorable fills during high-volatility or wide-spread periods
No position check or duplicate order protection, potentially opening repeated positions when signals persist
Depends on the custom CCI_Histogram indicator—if the indicator fails to load, the EA cannot run at all
When SignalBar=1, signals are only checked on new bars, potentially missing optimal entry points during fast market moves
improvements: 增加持仓检查逻辑，避免同一信号方向重复开仓，防止过度持仓
增加点差过滤和市场波动率过滤（如ATR），在不利交易条件下暂停开仓
improvements_en: Add position check logic to prevent duplicate entries in the same signal direction and avoid over-exposure
Add spread filter and volatility filter (e.g., ATR-based) to pause trading during unfavorable market conditions

risk_points: 止损1000点过大，在小账户或高杠杆下可能单笔亏损超出账户承受能力
缺少持仓检查，可能在已有同方向持仓时重复开仓导致风险叠加
反向信号平仓机制在震荡行情中可能频繁触发，导致连续亏损
risk_points_en: Stop loss of 1000 points is excessively large; on small accounts or high leverage, a single trade loss may exceed account tolerance
Lack of position checking may lead to duplicate entries in the same direction, compounding risk exposure
The reverse-signal exit mechanism may trigger frequently in ranging markets, leading to consecutive losses

summary_en: This EA trades based on a custom CCI_Histogram indicator, opening buy positions when the histogram transitions from neutral to positive zone and sell positions when it transitions from neutral to negative zone. It uses configurable money management modes, stop loss/take profit, and processes signals only on new bars to avoid over-trading.
